title: Create Target Array in the Given Order
summary: Given two arrays of integers, nums and index, create an empty target array by inserting the value nums[i] at the position index[i] for each i, following these steps until all elements in nums and index are processed.
statement: Given two arrays of integers, nums and index, create an empty target array by inserting the value nums[i] at the position index[i] for each i, following these steps until all elements in nums and index are processed. Return the resulting target array. It is assured that all insertion operations will be valid.
constraints: At step i insert nums[i] at index[i] in the current target.
hints: Maintain the target built from the processed prefix.
Insert each nums[i] at index[i] using list insertion.
The operation directly reproduces the specified construction step by step.
